# Test fixtures

**Every file here is hand-written and synthetic.** None of it is a captured response from a
real feed. Raw feed content is third-party copyrighted material (constraint C4 in the spec)
and never enters a commit — not in `data/`, and not here either.

The headlines are invented and deliberately implausible as news, so that a fixture can never
be mistaken for real content if one ever leaks into a digest.
